physical.scope: Observed registered prefix, complete sealed prehistory, no terminal invented; closure checked at actual checkpoint clock.

source.scope: exact production dispatch provenance and declared responsibility; legal-demand completeness requires additional independent opportunity replay

physical.seed_policy: Manifest seed for sealed prehistory; registered trajectory seed for subsequent draws. Previously scheduled completions retain their original sampled times.
physical.limitations: Greedy avoidable-idle integral requires separate interval replay; this checker does not certify it.

idle.limitation: Shared simulator replay; distinct greedy idle implementation. Independent source/physics checker is required separately; this is not an independent optimality proof.
